ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an organic phosphate/phosphonate-related transition-state structure, with P=O, two OEt substituents, and a reaction arrow on the right; the problem requires ignoring the arrow. In the central region, a carbon connected to the phosphonate can be seen, while also connected to the chiral carbon fragment on the left. The chiral carbon is labeled O⁻, and is connected through a solid wedge bond to the carbon chain on the left containing two double bonds; the end of this chain is connected to AcO, that is, an acetate fragment. Near the dashed bond, EtO2C, that is, an ethyl ester substituent, can also be seen. Reasoning: According to the specified method, write the ethyl ester near the dashed bond as CCOC(=O)C. This carbon continues to connect to the central skeleton bearing the phosphonate branch and the adjacent chiral alkoxide carbon, so write it as CCOC(=O)C([C@@H]...). The chiral carbon in the figure bears [O-], and is connected to the left diene side chain, encoded according to the double-bond configuration as [C@@H]([O-])/C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O. The phosphonate branch on the right is P(=O)(OCC)OCC. Combining gives CCOC(=O)C([C@@H]([O-])/C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O)P(=O)(OCC)OCC.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Start from the ethyl ester substituent visible near the dashed bond and write it as CCOC(=O)C. Continue through the carbon attached to both the phosphonate and the adjacent chiral alkoxide-bearing carbon. Add the chiral carbon as [C@@H] with substituents [O-] and the leftward diene chain. Encode the side chain as /C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O based on the two drawn double bonds and terminal acetate. Attach the right-hand phosphonate branch as P(=O)(OCC)OCC. Combining these fragments gives CCOC(=O)C([C@@H]([O-])/C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O)P(=O)(OCC)OCC.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个有机磷酸酯/膦酸酯相关的过渡态结构，右侧有 P=O、两个 OEt 取代基以及反应箭头；题目要求忽略箭头。中心区域可见一个与膦酸酯相连的碳，同时连有左侧的手性碳片段。手性碳上标有 O⁻，并通过粗楔键连接到左侧含两个双键的碳链；该链末端连接 AcO，即乙酸酯片段。靠近虚线键处还可见 EtO2C，即乙基酯取代基。推理：按指定方法，从靠近虚线键的乙基酯写作 CCOC(=O)C。该碳继续连接到带膦酸酯支链和相邻手性烷氧负离子碳的中心骨架，因此写作 CCOC(=O)C([C@@H]...). 图中手性碳带有 [O-]，并连接左侧二烯侧链，按双键构型编码为 [C@@H]([O-])/C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O。右侧膦酸酯支链为 P(=O)(OCC)OCC。合并得到 CCOC(=O)C([C@@H]([O-])/C=C/C=C/CCOC(C)=O)P(=O)(OCC)OCC。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply standard SMILES construction rules: expand Et as CC, AcO as O-C(=O)-CH3 written along the chain as CCOC(C)=O or equivalent orientation, write phosphonate as P(=O)(OCC)OCC, encode the negatively charged oxygen as [O-], encode the stereocenter with bracketed chiral carbon [C@@H], and preserve double-bond geometry with / markers.
